Control question: Current inventory of material AI systems and use cases exists
Every material use case has a named business owner and technical or security contact
1 - Partial or inconsistent: Ownership exists for some use cases
2 - Evidence in place and owned: Named accountable owners for material use cases

Control question: AI Act role and prohibited or high-risk relevance are documented
Applicable transparency duties are identified for each relevant system
Users are informed when they interact with AI where required
AI-generated or manipulated content controls are documented where Article 50 is relevant
2 - Evidence in place and owned: Documented marking or disclosure process with ownership

Control question: Material AI suppliers are reviewed for data use security access retention incidents and exit
1 - Partial or inconsistent: Review covers some topics or suppliers
2 - Evidence in place and owned: Repeatable supplier review with evidence and decisions

Control question: Identity permissions logging and monitoring match use-case sensitivity
1 - Partial or inconsistent: Baseline controls exist but gaps remain

Control question: Human review and escalation responsibility are explicit for material decisions or outputs
2 - Evidence in place and owned: Documented oversight triggers roles and escalation

Control question: Role-based AI literacy training is documented for relevant staff
2 - Evidence in place and owned: Role-based training with attendance or completion evidence

Control question: Approvals tests exceptions incidents and corrective actions are retained
2 - Evidence in place and owned: Defined evidence model with retrievable records

Control question: Model supplier data or purpose changes trigger reassessment
2 - Evidence in place and owned: Defined change triggers owner and review process
